title: invite_sent
description: An account was promoted off the waitlist and the invite email was queued. Emitted inside the promotion transaction, so it cannot survive a rollback or be lost by a commit. Promotion is idempotent, so this fires once per account rather than once per click.

invited_by_staff.description: False when the seed promoted them, which is how the first owner and any scripted invite arrive. Deliberately not the staff account's id: who let someone in is an audit question, and the audit trail is not the warehouse.
